checkpoints.quote: Based on the ticket description's warning about prioritizing high-impact issues over high event counts, BANKUI-3C8 appears critical due to its cascading impact, while BANKUI-5D6 may have high user exposure (58 users) despite fewer events. BANKUI-1A7 is never mentioned in the analysis; there is no discussion of its resolved status, its last-seen date after 4.7.0, or the need to reopen it.
